# Untouchable troop aura stages

Two isolated native processes replay the same 55-input prefix and instrument the
protected Stasis Crystal action. Each complete successor and its RNG match the
un-instrumented observation; player capture purity checks pass. Instrumentation
is development-only and opt-in for this boundary.

Both traces record six preview operations, followed by one real operation. In
the first preview, the target has seven horde stacks and changes from 40/49 to
28/28; the target cache remains unchanged throughout preview. The subsequent
real operation starts with four horde stacks, changes the target from 19/28 to
16/16, and removes its id from the cache. This documents one exact ordering,
not general support for arbitrary auras, previews or enchantments. The model's
guard remains in place until its full successor can be independently verified.
